primary.name: Warrior
primary.blurb: The tank: stands in front of the party, masters every weapon.

primary.name: Ranger
primary.blurb: Hardest class to hit; lands more blows and snares fleeing foes.

primary.name: Thief
primary.blurb: Covert strikes with daggers; huge damage, light defenses.

primary.name: Mage
primary.blurb: Ranged elemental carnage; light on armor, heavy on damage.

primary.name: Cleric
primary.blurb: Heals the party with vigor; essential to any dangerous outing.

remort.name: Knight
remort.blurb: Master of protection; rains blows and counters attacks.

remort.name: Strider
remort.blurb: Master of the bow; archery, snares, dual weapons.

remort.name: Assassin
remort.blurb: Deadliest single burst in the land; poisons and daggers.

remort.name: Wizard
remort.blurb: Master of elements and summonings; a staff-wielding terror.

remort.name: Priest
remort.blurb: The finest healer in the field; restores allies to full health.
